ri_lincoln_woods.name: Lincoln Woods
ri_lincoln_woods.note: Sources conflict: year-round listing vs spring/fall words vs winter-friendly forum posts; no months named.

il_the_holy_boulders.name: The Holy Boulders
il_the_holy_boulders.note: Mountain Project: visit October to early April, avoid May-Sept (humidity, ticks, poison ivy); Mad Boulder says fall and spring; forum says Midwest prime season Oct to late April.

or_smith_rock.name: Smith Rock
or_smith_rock.note: MP: best times are Spring and Fall, summer too hot; a guide names Mar-May and Sep-Nov, another Apr-May and Sep-Oct.

co_north.name: North
co_north.note: Boulder/Flatirons: climbable most of the year; guides split (spring/fall words vs Feb-May peak vs Jan-Feb); no agreed months.

co_south.name: South
co_south.note: Boulder/Flatirons: climbable most of the year; guides split (spring/fall words vs Feb-May peak vs Jan-Feb); no agreed months.

co_flagstaff.name: Flagstaff
co_flagstaff.note: Boulder/Flatirons: climbable most of the year; guides split (spring/fall words vs Feb-May peak vs Jan-Feb); no agreed months.

nv_first_pullout_calico_i.name: First Pullout (Calico I)
nv_first_pullout_calico_i.note: Guide: October to early April best for Red Rocks; Kaya: prime Nov-Mar with Sep/Oct and Apr/May shoulder; Calico sunny sport walls favour cooler months.

co_bank_the.name: Bank, The
co_bank_the.note: Prime time named as November through early May (Rove: Sep-May); fall/winter/spring words, summer too hot; CMC calls it a popular non-summer area. Shared window Nov-May.

co_shelf_road.name: Shelf Road
co_shelf_road.note: Prime time named as November through early May (Rove: Sep-May); fall/winter/spring words, summer too hot; CMC calls it a popular non-summer area. Shared window Nov-May.

ut_right_fork_2.name: Right Fork
ut_right_fork_2.note: Kaya: fall Sep-Nov prime, spring Mar-May excellent, summer off-season, winter marginal; other sources agree spring and fall (higher Right Fork areas cooler in summer).

al_horse_pens_40.name: Horse Pens 40
al_horse_pens_40.note: Blog: October through March prime (late Oct to mid Mar); MP: fall and winter best; Wikipedia: early fall through late spring. ClimbingAway Jan-Sep is an outlier.

co_buena_vista.name: Buena Vista
co_buena_vista.note: Conflict: sunny granite warm all winter (Mountain Mail) vs May, Jun, Sep, Oct (Adventure Collective); no firm months.

bc_grand_wall_boulders.name: Grand Wall Boulders
bc_grand_wall_boulders.note: Squamish-wide sources: prime season early April to October (summer driest; Oct best for hard sends), most stop Nov-Mar; no crag-specific month data found.

bc_murrin_park.name: Murrin Park
bc_murrin_park.note: Squamish-wide sources: prime season early April to October (summer driest; Oct best for hard sends), most stop Nov-Mar; no crag-specific month data found.

co_redgarden_wall.name: Redgarden Wall
co_redgarden_wall.note: Eldo-wide: spring and fall best; one guide Apr-Oct, another Sep-Oct; summer hot/stormy though shaded classics climbable; Redgarden falcon closure from Feb 1.

wy_sinks_canyon.name: Sinks Canyon
wy_sinks_canyon.note: Fall/winter/spring named by season words only (south-facing main wall good all winter, summer too hot); no months stated.

nb_cochrane_lane_cliffs.name: Cochrane Lane Cliffs
nb_cochrane_lane_cliffs.note: No season text found; chart values not readable.

nh_pawtuckaway.name: Pawtuckaway
nh_pawtuckaway.note: MP: best in autumn, bugs bad spring/early summer; forum names late Sept to mid Oct (later Oct also fine); spring also mentioned but buggy (May-June black flies).

ut_jungle_on_the_aquarius_plateau.name: Jungle, on the Aquarius Plateau
ut_jungle_on_the_aquarius_plateau.note: 10,400 ft; forum posts suggest fall into October and summer for cool temps, but no agreed months.

ga_rocktown.name: Rocktown
ga_rocktown.note: Kaya: October through March sweet spot, peak Nov and Feb; others say late fall through early spring/fall and winter; summer hot and humid.
